parameters.name: Data
parameters.description:
The date or month of the query.

- If the time granularity is 1 day, use the \`yyyymmdd\` format. Example: \`20201203\`.

- If the time granularity is 1 month, use the \`yyyymm\` format. Example: \`202012\`.

parameters.name: Metric
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the query. Valid values:

- \`1day\`: queries data by day.

- \`1month\`: queries data by month.

parameters.name: SecFunc
parameters.description:
The security feature. Valid values:

- \`waf\`: WAF

- \`tmd\`: IP rate limiting

- \`robot\`: bot traffic detection

- \`l4\_dm\_drop\`: Layer 4 domain name blocking
